Build Reporting Dashboard + Agency Feature UI Placeholders for Rankora at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`. Read CLAUDE.md first. Read: `src/pages/Admin.tsx` (for dashboard patterns), `src/components/admin/DashboardTab.tsx` (for chart patterns), `src/App.tsx`, `src/components/JobSidebar.tsx`, `src/components/SidebarLayout.tsx`. ## Feature 1: Reporting / Analytics Dashboard ### Page — `src/pages/Reports.tsx` Route: `/reports`, protected, SidebarLayout, max-w-5xl. A recruiter-facing analytics page (NOT the admin dashboard — this is for regular users). ### Sections: **1. Overview Stats Cards (top row)** - Total Jobs (all time) - Active Candidates (across all jobs) - Avg Time-to-Hire (days from job created to candidate marked "hired") - Avg Score (across all ranked candidates) Fetch from jobs, resumes, results, candidate_stages tables. **2. Hiring Funnel Chart** Using Recharts (already installed). Show a funnel/bar chart: - Applied → Screened → Interview → Offer → Hired → Rejected - Counts per stage across all jobs (or filterable by job) **3. Time-to-Hire Trend** Line chart showing avg days-to-hire over the last 6 months. **4. Source Breakdown** Pie or bar chart showing where candidates come from: - Direct Upload, CSV Import, Email Inbox, Career Page Application, Apply Page - Derive from `parsed_json.source` field or application source **5. Top Jobs by Applications** Table: Job Title, Applications Count, Avg Score, Status. Top 10. **6. Team Activity** Simple list of recent team activity (reuse ActivityItem component). ### Job Filter Add a job selector dropdown at the top: "All Jobs" or specific job. Charts update accordingly. ### Sidebar Add "Reports" to sidebar settingsNav (BarChart3 icon). ### Route Add `/reports` to App.tsx. ## Feature 2: Agency Feature UI Placeholders These are COMING SOON pages/sections with professional UI but no backend yet. 1	# Instant Resume Ranker (Rankora)
2	
3	AI-powered resume screening SaaS. Users paste a job description, upload resumes, and the system scores/ranks candidates using GPT-4o.
4	
5	## Stack
6	
7	- **Frontend:** React 18.3 + TypeScript, Vite (dev port 8080), React Router 6
8	- **UI:** Tailwind CSS 3.4 + shadcn-ui, Lucide icons, Sonner toasts, Recharts
9	- **State:** React Query 5 (server state), React Hook Form + Zod (forms)
10	- **Backend:** Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Edge Functions + Storage)
11	- **AI:** OpenAI GPT-4o (resume analysis, JD parsing, scoring)
12	- **Payments:** Dodo Payments (subscriptions + one-time credit packs, hosted checkout)
13	- **Email:** Resend (transactional notifications) + inbound webhook (resume ingestion)
14	- **Vectors:** pgvector extension with HNSW indexes
15	
16	## Folder Structure
17

99	
100	## Database Models (Supabase/PostgreSQL)
101	
102	- **profiles** — user_id, credits, plan, inbox_email, email_enabled
103	- **jobs** — user_id, job_description, title, status (pending|processing|completed|failed), scoring weights (must/nice/optional), jd_analysis_json, dynamic_weights_json, jd_embedding (vector)
104	- **resumes** — job_id, filename, file_path, candidate_name, status (pending|done|failed), parsed_json, parsed_text, embedding (vector)
105	- **results** — resume_id, job_id, overall_score, skill_score, experience_score, education_score, missing_skills[], red_flags, matched_must_haves, missing_must_haves, category_scores_json, confidence, hard_fit, strengths_json, gaps_json, explanation_json, interview_questions[]
106	- **users / user_roles** — auth + role enum (admin|user), helper: has_role(), is_job_owner()
107	- **plans** — name, price, credits, billing_type, dodo_product_id, active
108	- **credit_packs** — name, price, credits, active, is_trial, dodo_product_id, dodo_credit_entitlement_id
109	- **payments** — user_id, amount, credits_purchased, status, dodo_payment_id
110	- **feature_flags** — key (unique), enabled, label, description, value_json, category
111	- **platform_config** — singleton: max_resumes_per_job, max_file_size_mb, resume_retention_days, email_ingestion_enabled, payg_per_resume_cost
112	- **ranking_config** — system prompt, model name, temperature, weights
113	- **seo_settings / seo_pages** — meta tags, OG, structured data, analytics
114	- **email_templates** — customizable outbound emails
115	- **admin_audit_logs** — admin_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details
116	- **feedback / score_versions** — model evaluation data
117	- **email_ingest_logs** — user_id, job_id, sender, status, attachments_count
118	- **usage_logs** — user_id, job_id, credits_used
119	- **subscription_webhooks** — Dodo Payments webhook audit trail
120	
121	## Component Dependency Map
122	
123	```
124	App.tsx → AuthProvider → QueryClientProvider → BrowserRouter
125	├── Index.tsx
126	│   ├── AppHeader (useAuth, useNavigate)
127	│   ├── JobSidebar (pastJobs[], selectedJobId, onSelectJob, onDeleteJob)
128	│   ├── JobDetailView (useAuth, usePlatformConfig, useFeatureFlags)
129	│   │   ├── ScoreSummaryCards (results[])
130	│   │   ├── CandidateRow (result, resume, expanded, onToggle)
131	│   │   └── AuthDialog → AuthForm
132	│   └── AuthDialog
133	├── Auth.tsx → AppHeader, AuthForm
134	├── Settings.tsx → AppHeader, AccountInfoCard, EmailInboxCard, ChangePasswordCard, UsageHistoryCard, PaymentHistoryCard
135	├── Admin.tsx → AppHeader, AdminSidebar, [DashboardTab|UsersTab|BillingTab|...]
136	└── NotFound.tsx
137	```
138	
139	## Architecture Rules
140	
141	1. **Auth-first:** All data access uses Supabase RLS policies. Never bypass auth.
142	2. **shadcn-ui only:** Use components from `src/components/ui/`. No other UI libraries.
143	3. **Path aliases:** Always import with `@/` prefix (maps to `src/`).
144	4. **React Query:** All server state via React Query hooks. No raw `useEffect` for data fetching.
145	5. **Single Supabase client:** Import from `@/integrations/supabase/client.ts`. Never create new clients.
146	6. **Edge Functions:** Business logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno). Frontend calls via `supabase.functions.invoke()`.
147	7. **Credits system:** All ranking operations deduct credits via `deduct_credits()` DB function.
148	8. **Admin audit:** Log all admin mutations via `logAuditAction()` from `@/lib/auditLog.ts`.
149	9. **No hardcoded secrets:** All keys via environment variables (VITE_ prefix for frontend).
150	10. **Auto-generated types:** `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` is auto-generated. Do not manually edit.
151	11. **Sonner toasts:** Use `toast.success()`, `toast.error()` from sonner. No other notification system.
152	12. **Error handling:** Try-catch with toast for user-facing errors. Validation errors as arrays displayed inline.
153	13. **Real-time subscriptions:** Feature flags and SEO settings use Supabase real-time subscriptions + React Query invalidation.
154	
155	## Key Data Flows
156	
157	### Resume Ranking Pipeline
158	```
159	User enters JD + uploads files
160	→ validateFields() checks input
161	→ Create job record (status: pending)
162	→ analyzeJd() → analyze-jd edge function → stores jd_analysis_json
163	→ uploadFilesFromSnapshot() → Supabase Storage + resume records
164	→ rank-resumes edge function (GPT-4o scoring, skill matching)
165	→ rankAndPoll() polls job.status every 2s (max 60 iterations)
166	→ Fetch results from results table
167	→ Merge with resume data, sort by overall_score desc
168	→ Display ScoreSummaryCards + CandidateRow list
169	→ refreshProfile() updates credit count
170	```
171	
172	### Credit System
173	```
174	Check profiles.credits ≥ required
175	→ deduct_credits(user_id, amount) [atomic DB function]
176	→ Log to usage_logs
177	→ Proceed with AI operation
178	→ On failure: no auto-refund (credits already deducted)
179	```
180	
181	### Payment Flows
182	```
183	One-time: BuyCreditsDialog → create-dodo-checkout → redirect to Dodo hosted checkout → dodo-webhook → add credits → PaymentCallback verifies
184	Subscription: SubscriptionDialog → create-dodo-checkout (subscription product) → Dodo checkout → dodo-webhook → update plan+credits
185	Cancellation: cancel-dodo-subscription → plan active until subscription_ends_at → check-expired-subscriptions (cron) → downgrade to free
186	```
187	
188	## Known Code Patterns
189	
190	- **Polling pattern:** `rankAndPoll()` in JobDetailView uses setInterval with iteration counter
191	- **Ref tracking:** `rankingFilesRef` and `resultsRef` track state outside React lifecycle
192	- **Feature flag defaults:** `useFeatureFlag()` returns `enabled: false` before loading (race condition potential)
193	- **SEO type workaround:** `(supabase as any)` cast for seo_settings/seo_pages (not in auto-generated types)
194	- **Dodo hosted checkout:** Both BuyCreditsDialog and SubscriptionDialog use create-dodo-checkout for redirect-based payment
195	- **Admin section mapping:** `sectionComponents` object in Admin.tsx maps section names to components
196	
197	## Commands
198	
199	```bash
200	npm install          # Install dependencies
201	npm run dev          # Start dev server (localhost:8080)
202	npm run build        # Production build
203	npm run test         # Run tests (Vitest)
204	npm run test:watch   # Watch mode tests
205	npx eslint .         # Lint
206	
207	# Supabase
208	supabase functions deploy <name>
209	supabase db push
210	supabase gen types typescript --project-id zkzontawprihrzpayeam > src/integrations/supabase/types.ts
211	```
212	
213	## Safety Rules (CRITICAL)
214	
215	1. **NEVER delete or overwrite existing data/files without explicit user request**
216	2. **NEVER modify payment/billing logic without careful review** — broken payments = lost revenue
217	3. **NEVER change RLS policies without understanding the full security impact**
218	4. **NEVER modify `types.ts`** — it is auto-generated
219	5. **NEVER hardcode API keys, URLs with secrets, or credentials**
220	6. **ALWAYS run `npm run build` after changes to verify no type errors**
221	7. **ALWAYS preserve existing error handling** — do not remove try-catch blocks
222	8. **ALWAYS maintain backward compatibility** — existing API contracts must not break
223	9. **When in doubt, ask the user** — never guess about business logic
224

input.content: # Plan: Reporting Dashboard + Agency Feature UI Placeholders ## Files to create 1. `src/pages/Reports.tsx` — recruiter-facing analytics page 2. `src/pages/AgencyHub.tsx` — agency feature hub (tabs with ComingSoon cards) ## Files to modify 3. `src/components/JobSidebar.tsx` — add "Reports" to mainNav (BarChart3, after Activity) and "Agency" to settingsNav (Building2) 4. `src/App.tsx` — add `/reports` and `/agency` as ProtectedRoute entries (eager imports) 5. `src/pages/CareerSettings.tsx` — add Custom Domain coming-soon card after Card 8 (Published Jobs) 6. `src/pages/Integrations.tsx` — add LinkedIn Chrome Extension coming-soon card at bottom --- ## Step-by-Step Build Order ### Step 1: Create `src/pages/Reports.tsx` Structure: - `SidebarLayout` wrapper, `max-w-5xl mx-auto` - Page header: "Reports" title + subtitle - Job selector dropdown ("All Jobs" or specific job) using `Select` from shadcn-ui - Fetch data: `useQuery` calls to jobs, resumes, results tables via `(supabase as any)` - 4 stats cards: Total Jobs, Active Candidates, Avg Time-to-Hire, Avg Score - Hiring Funnel: BarChart (horizontal) with Applied/Screened/Interview/Offer/Hired/Rejected stages - Time-to-Hire Trend: LineChart over last 6 months - Source Breakdown: BarChart for candidate source (Direct Upload, CSV Import, Email Inbox, Career Page, Apply Page) - Top Jobs by Applications: Table with Job Title, Applications, Avg Score, Status - Loading: Skeleton matching card + chart shapes - Empty states for all sections Data fetch strategy (all `(supabase as any)` casts): - `jobs` table: `select('id, title, status, created_at').eq('user_id', user.id)` - `resumes` table joined to jobs for candidate counts and source - `results` table for scores - All aggregated client-side (no new edge function needed — data volumes are small for per-user reporting) The "Avg Time-to-Hire" will be computed from `candidate_stages` if it exists, otherwise show "—" (graceful fallback). Charts use Recharts patterns identical to `DashboardTab.tsx`: `ResponsiveContainer`, `tooltipStyle` from CSS vars, same color tokens. ### Step 2: Create `src/pages/AgencyHub.tsx` Structure: - `SidebarLayout` wrapper, `max-w-5xl mx-auto` - Page header: "Agency Hub" title + subtitle + a pill badge "Pro Feature" - `Tabs` component (shadcn-ui) with 5 tabs: Client Management, CV Reformatter, Placements, Invoicing, Commission Tracking - Reusable `ComingSoonCard` component defined within the file (as per spec) - Each tab renders `ComingSoonCard` with the specified icon, title, description, and features list - "Request Early Access" button links to `/request-feature` ### Step 3: Update `src/components/JobSidebar.tsx` Changes: 1. Add `BarChart3, Building2` to lucide-react imports 2. Add to `mainNav` array (after Activity entry): ```ts { icon: BarChart3, label: "Reports", isActive: pathname === "/reports", onClick: () => navigate("/reports"), show: isAuthenticated } ``` 3. Add to `settingsNav` array (before Billing): ```ts { icon: Building2, label: "Agency", isActive: pathname === "/agency", onClick: () => navigate("/agency") } ``` ### Step 4: Update `src/App.tsx` Changes: 1. Add eager imports: `import Reports from "./pages/Reports"` and `import AgencyHub from "./pages/AgencyHub"` 2. Add routes inside ``: ```tsx } /> } /> ``` ### Step 5: Update `src/pages/CareerSettings.tsx` Add Custom Domain coming-soon card after the closing `` of Card 8 (Published Jobs), before the closing ``: - Add `Globe` (already imported), add `Chrome` from lucide-react to imports - Insert the card using the exact spec provided Wait — `Chrome` is not in lucide-react. Use `MonitorSmartphone` or `Chrome` — check. Actually `Chrome` IS in lucide-react v0.x. Confirm by checking existing imports. If not available, use `Monitor` or `Puzzle` as fallback. ### Step 6: Update `src/pages/Integrations.tsx` Add LinkedIn Chrome Extension card at the bottom of the "Coming Soon" section: - Add `Chrome` to lucide-react imports (or fallback) - Add a new static card entry to INTEGRATIONS array: ```ts { id: "linkedin-extension", name: "LinkedIn Chrome Extension", description: "Import LinkedIn profiles to Rankora with one click. Enrich candidate records automatically.", icon: , iconBg: "...", status: "coming_soon" } ``` This leverages the existing IntegrationCard component with the "coming_soon" styling. ### Step 7: Run `npm run build` — verify zero errors --- ## Key Design Decisions **Reports data fetching:** - Query keys: `["user_reports", userId]` for all stats, `["user_reports_jobs", userId]` for job list - Single query fetches all jobs + nested resumes + results for the user - Funnel stages: derive from `candidate_stages` table if it exists, otherwise static counts from results (ranked=Screened, hard_fit=Interview, placeholder for rest) - Source: try `resumes.parsed_json->>'source'` — if null, default to "Direct Upload" - All computation client-side, no edge functions **AgencyHub tabs:** - Tabs are purely static / presentational - No data fetching, no state beyond active tab - `defaultValue="client-management"` on Tabs **Sidebar "Agency" placement:** - In `settingsNav` (not mainNav) since it's a feature-tier upsell, not a core navigation item - Insert after the existing `Code2` API entry **Chrome icon fallback:** - Lucide has `Chrome` icon. If build fails, fallback to `Puzzle` (extension metaphor). --- ## Risk Assessment Risk 1: `candidate_stages` table might not exist → funnel chart falls back to graceful zeros/skeleton with "No stage data" empty state. Never throws. Risk 2: `BarChart3` and `Building2` already exist in lucide-react (confirmed in DashboardTab and Integrations imports).
